_purpose: Test economic pressure mechanics, negative soulcredit characters (-3 to -5), currency scarcity, vendor lockouts, debt collection NPCs, moral compromises (illegal work vs. poverty), desperation-driven decisions. ALL AGENTS USE BATCH PROXY FOR 50% COST REDUCTION.

_scenario_hint: Freeborn District (void_level 4, poverty zone), three characters drowning in ACG debt (-3 to -5 soulcredit). Offered high-risk job: smuggle illegal hollow seeds to void cultists for 15 Drip payment. Alternative: legal work pays 2 Drip, not enough to make minimum debt payment (5 Drip due in 8 rounds). Consequences: miss payment = repo agents, accept job = void exposure + criminal record. Vendors refuse service to negative SC characters. Desperation mechanic: low resources force moral compromises.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: First config testing economic pressure system, all characters start negative soulcredit (-3 to -5), currency scarcity mechanics, vendor soulcredit gating, debt collection clock pressure, moral choice (illegal high-pay vs. legal poverty), desperation-driven gameplay, repo NPC antagonists
_design_notes.character_innovation: All characters start negative SC, minimal starting inventory (poverty), counterfeit credentials, desperate survival gear, hollow seeds as plot MacGuffin
_design_notes.llm_provider: ALL AGENTS USE BATCH PROXY (GPT-5-MINI underlying) - 50% cost reduction via batching, plus GPT-5-MINI's 8x cheaper output tokens. Temperature 1.0 for all agents.
